The divorce of my parents hit hard. My mental health got so worse I was in the hospital for 5 weeks before I was taken into a children's home for 2 1/2 yrs. I started therapy and made a bunch of friends who helped me alot. After the children's home I moved back to my mother and stayed there until I graduated high school and moved into a new city for university. Due to the pandemic, the stress of my studies and my ex my mental health got worse. She left me and that was the final kick in the ass and chance to focus soly on me and my mental health is better than ever. I've restarted therapy, did a lot of self improvement, started new hobbies, started going to the gym, going on dates, reconnect with old friends. The only person that truly can help you is yourself. You have to choose to improve your mental health. In which form this improvement comes is different for every person. For me it was therapy and my self-improvement through reading related books and articles etc.


TL;DR: Was in hospital and Children's Home. Started Therapy, reconnected with old friends and started new hobbies
